# Stats Hours with Itchy

An open-access statistics book that teaches the whole climb — from the straight line through a cloud of
points to models that know which animals are related, and how much of a trait is inherited
(heritability) — **in one engine**, one piece of fitting software used for every model in the
book: [`drmTMB`](https://github.com/itchyshin/drmTMB) in R and
[`DRM.jl`](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRM.jl) in Julia. It is a reboot of *Statistical Models with
R: An Introduction with Sparrows* (drafted 2009–2010, never published), keeping its office-hours cast, its
running organisms, and its habit of leaving the mistakes in.

![The climb — twelve rungs and a coda, one engine, each rung freeing one thing the rung before it held fixed.](book/img/the-climb.svg){.climb}

<p>All ten classes planned for version 1, the fifth in two hours, with Appendices A and B, the preface and the coda. Every number and figure on these pages was produced by running the code shown beside it, and every chapter has been read by a statistician whose job was to find fault with it. Everything else so far is a plan; see
<a href="https://github.com/itchyshin/stats-hours/blob/main/docs/the-climb.md">the full outline</a>.</p>
